title: Cassette
summary: A sound recorder with a tape-deck look and crash-safe WAV takes.
description: Records from any USB sound card or headset to WAV files: a level meter with a target zone, software gain, a record timer, trim and split, and playback with 5x scan. Crash-safe: a take survives a power cut up to the last sync. No cloud: nothing leaves the board. Needs a screen of at least 480x320 (portrait 320x480 in PDA mode).
depends: libstdc++6, libgcc-s1, libfreetype6, libinput10, libxkbcommon0, libasound2t64 | libasound2
